declined_list_rows_checked: favourite-and-hold (the rule is a gap rule, not a favourite rule)
uniqueness.difference: the ladder-implied chance of a DIFFERENT strike (the 15 minute market's own), by interpolation, scored on the 15 minute result; no outside price

extracts: quote-data checkout: quotes/<date>/<HHMM>/ladder.csv.gz, quotes.csv.gz, results.csv.gz for date directories 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-01
data.independence_note: Oct 29 to Nov 1 are the development days of BOOKIMB1, FLOWHR1, MAKERMID1, MAKERTAIL1, ENTRYREPLAY1 block D and CFRTI-B: not independent of theirs

split.release_rule: outcome read only for closes after the last of the cards' reads or after 2026-12-15T23:59Z, whichever is earlier; count-only logging from Nov 16 allowed

event.entry_rule: buy YES at the 15 minute ask if gap > 0, else NO at 1 - the YES bid; one per hourly close

prediction: at least 100 events with |gap| >= 0.04, cash PF at 2c of 1.3 or more with each half above 1.0
kill: under 100 usable events, or 2c PF under 1.0 in either half

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF 1c and 2c, n, days
